messages.content: I just got back from a business trip and the credenza I ordered is not at my office. Tracking says it was delivered to the loading dock on Jan 19 but no one at my office received it.
The freight carrier delivered it to the loading dock at your business address and took a delivery photo. Did you check with building management? Large items are sometimes moved by facilities staff.

I checked with building management and our office manager. No one has any record of this delivery. The loading dock is shared and unsecured — anyone could have taken it. I was out of town and couldn't accept the delivery in person.

I understand the frustration but the carrier confirmed delivery to the address you provided. We shipped via freight with tracking and it was delivered. If you chose a business address, someone at the business should have been available to receive it.
